title: Best Sales Strategy Consultants (2026): Build a Sales Process
description: How to hire a sales strategy consultant to design your sales process, scripts, pipeline and offers: deliverables, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Sales strategy consultants help businesses sell more consistently: defining ideal customers, designing a sales process, setting up a pipeline, writing scripts and objection handling, and planning pricing and offers. They are especially useful for founders and small teams who sell without a clear system. Strategy goes wrong when advice is generic, ignores your sales cycle or pushes aggressive tactics that damage trust. This guide helps you build a sales approach that fits your business.

faq.q: Is this the same as hiring a salesperson?
faq.a: No. A consultant designs the system; salespeople use it.
Often an ideal customer profile, process map, scripts, email templates and pipeline setup advice.
Many advise on packaging and offers. Final pricing decisions are yours.

faq.q: Do they set up a CRM?
faq.a: Some do. Clarify whether tool setup is included.
Conversion rates between pipeline stages, sales cycle length and revenue.
